column3: This is BlockID Business Passport, from Sydney: know the business you invest in. Every shareholder, large or small, gets a live view of the business they own, a share register on blockchain, and dividends paid straight to their wallet.
Today, investors lose sight of a business the day they invest. The numbers are hard to trust, ownership sits in a spreadsheet, and dividends are slow, or never arrive.
This is the live app, on testnet. No sign-up: you land in a demo investor account with sample data. My portfolio shows each holding at the latest approved price, and the dividends paid.
Each holding shows your stake, a price that only moves when a new value is approved, and the business updates every investor gets at the same time.
A business, or an investor, starts by pasting a website.
AI agents read the site, find competitors and analyse the market, step by step. They hold no keys. They can only propose.
The report gives a grade, a business score and a value range. Every figure links to its source. No source, no number.
A person approves every step in the admin console, signed by an admin wallet. Only then does the issuer act.
The isolated issuer creates the share register on BlockID chain and copies it to Ethereum and HashKey Chain. This cap table is read straight from the chain.
Businesses can open share offerings with the dilution shown first, and dividends are paid to every wallet, with no gas for holders.
Don't trust us. Your browser hashes the report and compares it with three blockchains. Change one number, and it turns red.
On HashKey Chain, our AgentProvenance contract records which agent proposed each action, and which person approved it.
BlockID HR reviews the founding team. Each requirement of the role is checked against public sources and the CV: met, partly met, or not found.
Agents propose. Humans approve. Chains prove. AI runs with no keys, one admin approval unlocks the issuer, and every step is recorded on chain.

Today the whole flow runs live on testnet: fourteen sample listings, forty-two token contracts on three chains, every report verified on chain, and more than five hundred tests. We have no real users yet.
Next: our first pilot businesses in Australia and Vietnam, investor communities and licensed partners. Try it at eth dot blockid dot au. Thank you.
